comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: from the log, it looks like the wait time for port 22 to be shutdown is not long enough and cause the test failure. It is unclear why this is triggered, could be host machine becomes slow. local run cannot reproduce this problem unless i artificially generate the delay to install the acl.
